note: Wave A2, sandbox (AI proposal, not the Theory Card; the author asked to research every option). Adds the two Higgs-dilaton terms (xi_chi |chi|^2 R, which B1 shows the card generates anyway, and a quartic portal alpha psi^2 |chi|^2 replacing the trilinear g_c). All mass ratios become coupling ratios and the matter-space exchange returns through a dimensionless portal, but the hierarchy is moved into small couplings (alpha = 7.4e-38 xi_psi for the nucleon lane, beta/xi^2 = 2.9e-120), not explained. The decoupling of the dilaton from matter and the n_s - w0 relation are literature results, not derived here. Adopting the extension is the author's decision (Theory Card v2). Not UET-distinct.
